need.current_gap: Volvence has norm, noop, safety, and lineage gates but lacks a formal cross-effect matrix showing when a target intervention harms unrelated behavior, already-correct inputs, robustness, SLOs, or rollback fidelity.
falsification_criteria: Cross-effects are large, asymmetric, unstable, or not bounded by dose/norm controls.
Rollback fails to recover exact artifact/wiring lineage or post-rollback behavior.
A risk predictor only tracks evaluator labels or cannot generalize across prompt, role, language, encoding, or model revision.
protected_boundaries: This Demand waits for accepted readout, substrate-authority, and per-instance-headroom evidence plus a separately designed task.
Risk prediction is read-only and cannot be written as reward, credit, or an alternate semantic owner.
No development matrix authorizes ModificationGate, SHADOW, canary, ACTIVE, or production wiring.
need.required_outcome: Produce a frozen target-by-side-effect matrix with paired controls, perturbation families, dose curves, capability tasks, latency/resource telemetry, predictive risk readouts, and exact rollback drills.
success_criteria: Target effects remain positive across frozen perturbations while unrelated capability tax, reverse effects, and already-correct damage remain under preregistered limits.
Strict noop and rollback recovery satisfy exact identity or explicitly declared behavior-equivalence checks.
A read-only side-effect predictor improves risk triage without becoming a PE/credit learning signal.

objective: Quantify target effects, cross-effects, unrelated capability tax, reverse effects, perturbation robustness, latency, strict-noop identity, and rollback recovery for bounded relationship steering before any production promotion path is designed.
title: Build a predictive steering side-effect and rollback matrix
